SELECT tenant_id,
    id AS business_id,
    slug,
    core10.owner_access_metric_v1(id, 'business_owner'::text) AS active_business_owners,
    core10.owner_access_metric_v1(id, 'manager'::text) AS active_managers,
    core10.owner_access_metric_v1(id, 'investor'::text) AS active_investors,
    core10.owner_access_metric_v1(id, 'site_grant'::text) AS active_site_grants,
    core10.owner_access_metric_v1(id, 'access_change'::text) AS audited_access_changes,
    false AS real_auth_account_verified
   FROM core10.businesses b
  WHERE core10.can_manage(tenant_id, id);

SELECT b.tenant_id,
    b.id AS business_id,
    b.slug,
    b.status,
    c.display_name,
    c.brand_hex,
    c.setup_mode,
    c.setup_status,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM core10.sites s
          WHERE (s.business_id = b.id)) AS visible_sites,
    ( SELECT count(*) AS count
           FROM core10.business_module_settings_v1 m
          WHERE (m.business_id = b.id)) AS visible_modules
   FROM (core10.businesses b
     JOIN core10.business_configuration_v1 c ON ((c.business_id = b.id)));

SELECT tenant_id,
    business_id,
    site_id,
    location_id,
    item_id,
    sum(delta) AS net_movement
   FROM core10.stock_movements
  GROUP BY tenant_id, business_id, site_id, location_id, item_id;
